node_notes.OLEDDriver: The SH1106 driver sends initialization commands and framebuffer pages. firmware/drivers/sh1106/sh1106.c delegates the actual bus send to platform_io_transmit.
node_notes.Ride: This module detects ride events from acceleration samples and derives the alert LED blink state. firmware/modules/ride_events.c applies the configured thresholds and alert timing.
node_notes.LED: The PA5 indicator reflects the alert blink state computed by ride_events. platform_io.c applies the board's active-high LED level with HAL_GPIO_WritePin.
node_notes.Sensors: This service schedules MPU6050 and DHT22 work, calibrates acceleration, and publishes the current snapshot. firmware/services/sensors.c uses 10 ms IMU and 2000 ms DHT timing from app_config.h.
node_notes.FgTelemetry: This generated module captures boot diagnostics and polls runtime telemetry using the UART handle supplied by the application. firmware/telemetry/firmgen_telemetry.c uses HAL_UART_Transmit when the debug telemetry profile is enabled.
node_notes.I2C: This is the shared I2C1 link used by the MPU6050 and SH1106. platform_io.c configures PB8/PB9 as I2C1 alternate-function pins and performs the HAL transfers.
node_notes.App: app_start coordinates initialization and the cooperative runtime loop. firmware/app/app.c calls the sensor, ride-event, display, and telemetry services in that loop.
node_notes.MPUDriver: The driver checks the MPU identity, configures its registers, and decodes acceleration axes. firmware/drivers/mpu6050/mpu6050.c accesses the hardware through the platform I/O callbacks.
node_notes.OLED: The SH1106 displays the startup splash, sensor dashboard, and selected ride event. display.c uses address 0x3C and sends display pages through I2C1 on PB8/PB9.
node_notes.Telemetry: The service formats sensor and event data as VPD1 CSV records and schedules them at APP_TELEMETRY_PERIOD_MS. firmware/services/telemetry.c submits each record to platform_io_telemetry.
node_notes.UART: USART2 carries diagnostic logs and queued VPD1 telemetry, with TX on PA2 and RX on PA3. app_config.h defines the pins and 115200 baud; platform_io.c initializes and writes the UART.
node_notes.Display: This service owns splash timing and dashboard rendering from the sensor snapshot. firmware/services/display.c transfers SH1106 pages and updates the displayed event message.
node_notes.MPU: The MPU6050 supplies acceleration samples used for calibration and ride-event detection. sensors.c configures and reads it through the driver at address 0x68, and app_config.h supplies that address.
node_notes.DHT: The DHT22 provides temperature and humidity for the dashboard and telemetry. platform_io.c performs the start pulse and frame read on PB4, while sensors.c validates and decodes the frame.
node_notes.Platform: This STM32-specific module owns GPIO, I2C1, TIM3 timing, and USART2 transfers. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c configures PB8/PB9, PB4, PA5, and the USART2 pins from app_config.h.
node_notes.Console: This is the UART logging sink for boot, sensor, display, and event diagnostics. platform_io_log sends log text with HAL_UART_Transmit through USART2.

node_notes.EventChanged: Display and event logging work runs only when the newly selected event differs from the previous one. This comparison is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.IOReady: This branch handles platform initialization failure by returning instead of entering the application loop. The condition is the platform_io_init result in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.UpdateRide: The event module selects the current alert and calculates the LED state. firmware/app/app.c calls ride_events_update after sampling.
node_notes.SampleRide: The application submits the current acceleration sample or NULL to the ride-event module. firmware/app/app.c calls ride_events_sample in both branches.
node_notes.SetEvent: On an event change the app updates the display message and writes the selection or clear message to the log. The operations are in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.Snapshot: The application obtains the current sensor snapshot after processing timed reads. firmware/services/sensors.c exposes it through sensors_snapshot.
node_notes.PollFirmware: Each loop iteration polls generated telemetry and drains pending platform UART bytes. firmware/app/app.c calls firmgen_telemetry_poll and platform_io_poll before processing readings.
node_notes.Start: app_start starts the generated telemetry component before initializing application services. The call is visible in firmware/app/app.c at the beginning of the entry function.
node_notes.RenderDisplay: The service advances splash/dashboard state and transfers any due display page. firmware/services/display.c handles splash timing and refreshes through the SH1106 driver.
node_notes.Led: The computed alert state is applied to the PA5 indicator every loop iteration. firmware/app/app.c calls platform_io_led, implemented with HAL_GPIO_WritePin in platform_io.c.
node_notes.DisplayReady: The display service is advanced only when initialization succeeded. firmware/app/app.c checks is_display_ready before calling display_process.
node_notes.InitSensors: The loop's sensor state and ride-event state are initialized after platform I/O. The calls are sensors_init and ride_events_init in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.EmitTelemetry: The application submits the current snapshot and event to the telemetry service on every loop pass. firmware/services/telemetry.c applies the configured period before queueing a VPD1 record.
node_notes.AccelValid: A valid acceleration snapshot is submitted as a sample; otherwise the event history is explicitly invalidated with NULL. The branch appears in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.InitIO: The application initializes its STM32-owned I/O before using sensors or display. The operation is platform_io_init in firmware/app/app.c and firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c.
node_notes.ReadSensors: The sensor service performs time-gated IMU and DHT work, including calibration and validity updates. firmware/services/sensors.c implements this in sensors_process.
node_notes.InitDisplay: The application initializes the SH1106 display and retains whether it is usable. firmware/app/app.c calls display_init before sensor setup.
node_notes.DisplayActive: Ride-event sampling is gated until the display is ready and its splash phase has ended. The condition is in firmware/app/app.c before the ride-event calls.

sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Main as Core main
  participant App as app_start
  participant Platform as platform_io
  participant Sensors as sensors service
  participant MPU as MPU6050
  participant DHT as DHT22
  participant Display as display service and SH1106
  participant Ride as ride_events
  participant Telemetry as VPD1 telemetry
  participant UART as USART2

  Main->>App: Call app_start
  App->>Platform: firmgen_telemetry_start with UART handle
  App->>Platform: platform_io_init
  alt Platform I/O initialization succeeds
    App->>Display: display_init
    Display->>Platform: Initialize SH1106 and clear pages over I2C1
    App->>Sensors: sensors_init
    Sensors->>Platform: Read MPU identity and configure registers over I2C1
    Platform->>MPU: I2C1 transactions at address 0x68
    Sensors->>Platform: Log MPU initialization result on USART2
    loop Cooperative app_start loop
      App->>Platform: firmgen_telemetry_poll and platform_io_poll
      Platform->>UART: Send pending diagnostic or telemetry bytes
      App->>Sensors: sensors_process with current tick
      opt MPU sampling interval elapsed
        Sensors->>Platform: Read acceleration registers over I2C1
        Platform->>MPU: Read accelerometer data at address 0x68
      end
      opt DHT startup and sampling intervals elapsed
        Sensors->>Platform: platform_io_dht_frame on PB4
        Platform->>DHT: Drive start pulse and read response frame
      end
      App->>Sensors: sensors_snapshot
      alt Display is ready and splash is complete
        alt Acceleration is valid
          App->>Ride: ride_events_sample with acceleration
        else Acceleration is invalid
          App->>Ride: ride_events_sample with NULL
        end
        App->>Ride: ride_events_update
        alt Event changed
          App->>Display: display_set_event
          App->>Platform: Log event change
        else Event unchanged
          Note over App,Ride: Keep the existing event state
        end
      else Display is not ready or splash is active
        Note over App,Ride: Ride-event sampling is deferred
      end
      App->>Platform: platform_io_led with alert state

      end
    end
  else Platform I/O initialization fails
    App-->>Main: Return from app_start
  end
